title: Keychron keyboard extras
about: Keychron's own raw-HID commands on top of VIA (22 Oct 2026), written only from docs/brands/keychron.md, which cites Keychron's QMK fork (branch 2025q3, keyboards/keychron/common/: keychron_raw_hid.h/.c, debounce/keychron_debounce.c/.h, wireless/wireless.c, wireless_config.h, usb_report_rate.c, nkro.c). Keys, layers, macros and VIA lighting stay with DeviceHub's own VIA keyboard code; this file only adds the A7 'misc' settings: debounce, the wireless backlight-off and sleep timers, and the report rate. Each one is offered only when the board's own A7 01 feature bits say it has it (sheet section 2: 'Use these, not the model name, to decide what to show'). Byte offsets count from 0 at the first byte of the 32-byte report, which is the sheet's byte 0 (QMK raw HID has no report id). Simulated only (tests/sim-keychron-via.mjs); never run on a keyboard.

transport.note: sheet section 2 'Plain VIA': raw HID usage page FF60, usage 61, 32-byte reports both ways (QMK default, RAW_EPSIZE 32)

cable.label: USB cable
cable.note: sheet section 2 'Wired, 2.4 GHz and Bluetooth': Pro boards answer on USB only and the receiver's FF60 collection is unconfirmed, so only the cable is supported

probes.name: debounce
probes.note: A7 01 byte 5 bit 2 = debounce group (keychron_raw_hid.h MISC_*)

probes.name: lpm
probes.note: A7 01 byte 5 bit 4 = wireless sleep (LPM) group

probes.name: reportRate
probes.note: A7 01 byte 5 bit 5 = report rate group

models.name: Keychron Q1 Pro
models.note: KQ-bt q1_pro; built from an older branch: whether it answers A7 at all is unconfirmed (sheet section 6), the probe decides

models.name: Keychron Q1 HE
models.note: KQ q1_he; the analog matrix A9 is never sent

models.name: Keychron K2 HE
models.note: KQ k2_he; the analog matrix A9 is never sent

models.name: Keychron V1 8K
models.note: KQ v1_8k (USB_REPORT_INTERVAL_ENABLE: the report rate board)

replies.note: sheet section 2: same frame, reply echoes the header (A7 + sub-command); reply status in byte 2 (00 ok, 01 fail); an unknown A7 sub-command answers FF 00 and an unknown first byte falls through to VIA, which answers FF

miscInfo.note: MISC_GET_PROTOCOL_VER: bytes 3-4 version LE, byte 5 which groups exist (keychron_raw_hid.c)

debounceGet.note: DEBOUNCE_GET: byte 4 type, byte 5 time ms (keychron_debounce.c)

setDebounceType.note: DEBOUNCE_SET: byte 2 type, byte 3 time; the time is sent back as just read

setDebounceTime.note: DEBOUNCE_SET: the type is sent back as just read

lpmGet.note: WIRELESS_LPM_GET: bytes 3-4 backlight-off s, bytes 5-6 sleep s, uint16 LE (wireless.c)

setBacklightOff.note: WIRELESS_LPM_SET: bytes 2-5 the same two values; the sleep time is sent back as just read

setSleepTime.note: WIRELESS_LPM_SET: the backlight-off time is sent back as just read

rateGet.note: REPORT_RATE_GET: byte 3 divider, byte 4 allowed mask (usb_report_rate.c)

nkroGet.note: NKRO_GET: byte 3 bit 0 on, bit 1 switchable, bit 2 adaptive (nkro.c); read only

reads.name: misc
reads.note: a board without Keychron commands answers FF: then nothing below is asked (sheet section 4 probe order)

debounceType.note: keychron_debounce.h types 0-6; any other code = not reported

reportRate.note: only the dividers the Fn-combo code names (sheet section 3); 2, 4, 5, 6 follow from 2^n - 1 but are unconfirmed, so they read as not reported and are never written

settings.label: Debounce method
settings.hint: Saved on the keyboard at once.

write.note: keep: a method that caps the time (type 5, 127 ms) would change it; then the old method is put back

settings.label: Debounce time
settings.hint: 0 = none. Saved on the keyboard at once.
settings.note: the firmware takes 0-255; the page stops at 100 so a slip cannot make typing lag by a quarter second

settings.label: Backlight off after
settings.hint: Wireless boards. Setting it nudges the mouse cursor (or taps left Shift) once to restart the radio's timer.
settings.note: the firmware refuses under 5 s (wireless_lpm_set); the maximum is the page's, not the firmware's

settings.label: Sleep after
settings.hint: Wireless boards (default 7200 s). Setting it nudges the mouse cursor (or taps left Shift) once to restart the radio's timer.
settings.note: the firmware refuses under 60 s; default 7200 (wireless_config.h CONNECTED_IDLE_TIME)

settings.label: Report rate
settings.hint: Saved on the keyboard at once.

stepBack.note: sheet section 4 'Never': do not run beside Keychron Launcher or usevia.app. Both are usually a browser tab, which a process list cannot see: close them before changing settings here. The process names are not from a source.

unsupported: keys, layers, macros and VIA lighting (DeviceHub's VIA keyboard page has them)
snap click (SOCD) pairs (not yet: a pair editor)
switching NKRO (2025q3 firmware refuses it by design; shown read only)
Keychron per-key lighting A8 (not yet: a per-key editor)
HE boards' actuation and rapid trigger (A9: not mapped in any source)
battery (no raw HID battery command exists)
the 2.4 GHz receiver and Bluetooth (only the cable is documented)
report rates 2000, 500, 250 and 125 Hz (their dividers are unconfirmed)

never.why: analog matrix on HE boards: actuation and rapid trigger are not mapped (sheet section 4 'Never')
DIP switch get: not mapped (sheet section 4)
DIP switch set: not mapped (sheet section 4)
NKRO set: refused by 2025q3 firmware, not offered
snap click set: not offered by this driver
snap click save to EEPROM: not offered by this driver
